source.author: cic
source.text: hic et bella gerebat ut adulescens, cum plane grandis esset, et Hannibalem iuveniliter exsultantem patientia sua molliebat; de quo praeclare familiaris noster Ennius: unus homo nobis cunctando restituit rem; noenum rumores ponebat ante salutem; ergo plusque magisque viri nunc gloria claret.
source.text_original: hic et bella gerebat ut adulescens, cum plane grandis esset, et Hannibalem iuveniliter exsultantem patientia sua molliebat; de quo praeclare familiaris noster Ennius:  unus homo nobis cunctando restituit rem; noenum rumores ponebat ante salutem; ergo plusque magisque viri nunc gloria claret.
source.text_english: He also waged wars as a young man, though he was quite old, and he softened Hannibal’s youthful fury by his endurance; concerning him our friend Ennius said excellently: one man, by delaying, restored our state to us; he did not place rumor before safety; therefore the glory of that man now shines all the more and more.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ego quondam miles, nunc ueteranus et tuas et aliorum debeo laudare uictorias, non ipse rursus effeto corpore dimicare, ne, si me ascribendum frequenter inpuleris, illius recorder historiae, quod Hannibalem iuueniliter exultantem Quintus Maximus patientia sua fregerit.
reuse.text_original: ego quondam miles, nunc ueteranus et tuas et aliorum debeo laudare uictorias, non ipse rursus effeto corpore dimicare, ne, si me ascribendum frequenter inpuleris, illius recorder historiae, quod Hannibalem iuueniliter exultantem Quintus Maximus patientia sua fregerit.
reuse.text_english: I was once a soldier; now, as a veteran, I ought to praise both your victories and those of others, not to fight again myself with my worn-out body, lest, if you often press me into service, I remember that story in which Quintus Maximus broke Hannibal, exulting in his youth, by his patience.
